### Harmony integration options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description

Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--harmony_theta`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Diversity clustering penalty parameter. Can be set as a single value for all batch observations or as multiple values, one for each observation in the batches defined by --input_obs_batch_label. theta=0 does not encourage any diversity. Larger values of theta result in more diverse clusters."
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `2.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Neighbor classifier arguments

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--knn_weights`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Weight function used in prediction. Possible values are:
`uniform` (all points in each neighborhood are weighted equally) or
`distance` (weight points by the inverse of their distance)
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"uniform"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"uniform"`, `"distance"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--knn_n_neighbors`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The number of neighbors to use in k-neighbor graph structure used for fast approximate nearest neighbor search with PyNNDescent.
Larger values will result in more accurate search results at the cost of computation time.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `15`

[Min]{.arg-key} `5`
:::
::::
:::::

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"output.h5mu"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the predicted cell labels.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_pred"` suffix.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_probability`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the probability of the predictions.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_probability"` suffix.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obsm_integrated`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which .obsm slot to store the integrated embedding.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"X_integrated_harmony"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_compression`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The compression format to be used on the output h5mu object.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`, `"lzf"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/annotation/harmony_knn/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/workflows/annotation/harmony_knn);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/annotation/harmony_knn/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
